datasets.name: tiles
queryLines:
SELECT
  ROUND(100 * AVG(CASE WHEN exam_form_status_code <> 'unknown' AND dx_completed_status_code <> 'unknown'
                        AND probing_chart_status_code <> 'unknown' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 1) AS completeness_pct,
  ROUND(100 * AVG(CASE WHEN rules_v0_status_code = truth_status_code THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 1) AS accuracy_pct,
  ROUND(100 * AVG(CASE WHEN rules_design_status_code = truth_status_code THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 1)
    AS accuracy_design_pct,
  (SELECT ROUND(100 * (MAX(periodontitis_ratio) - MIN(periodontitis_ratio)), 1) FROM health_transformation_lab.gold_perio_bench.dq_prevalence
    WHERE level_code = 'clinic' AND method_name = 'algorithm_design') AS consistency_pts,
  (SELECT ROUND(100 * better_ratio, 1) FROM health_transformation_lab.gold_perio_bench.dq_temporal_change WHERE method_name = 'algorithm_design')
    AS implausible_pct,
  COUNT(*) AS n_visits
FROM health_transformation_lab.gold_perio_bench.fact_visit_evidence

datasets.name: missingness
queryLines:
SELECT evidence_column_name AS evidence_column, ROUND(missing_pct, 1) AS pct_missing, missing_count AS n_missing,
  row_count AS n_rows
FROM health_transformation_lab.gold_perio_bench.dq_column_missing
ORDER BY missing_pct DESC

datasets.name: checks
queryLines:
SELECT clinic_code AS clinic, check_category_code AS category, check_name, checked_count AS n_checked,
  failed_count AS n_fail, ROUND(100 * pass_ratio, 2) AS pass_pct, check_status_code AS status
FROM health_transformation_lab.gold_perio_bench.dq_check
ORDER BY CASE WHEN clinic_code = 'All' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, clinic_code, check_category_code, check_name

datasets.name: accuracy
queryLines:
SELECT clinic_code AS clinic, 'Exam form' AS evidence_source,
  CASE WHEN exam_form_status_code <> 'unknown' THEN 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS answered_pct,
  CASE WHEN exam_form_status_code = 'unknown' THEN NULL WHEN exam_form_status_code = truth_status_code THEN 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS agree_pct
FROM health_transformation_lab.gold_perio_bench.fact_visit_evidence
UNION ALL

SELECT clinic_code AS clinic, 'Diagnosis codes, done' AS evidence_source,
  CASE WHEN dx_completed_status_code <> 'unknown' THEN 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS answered_pct,
  CASE WHEN dx_completed_status_code = 'unknown' THEN NULL WHEN dx_completed_status_code = truth_status_code THEN 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS agree_pct
FROM health_transformation_lab.gold_perio_bench.fact_visit_evidence
UNION ALL

SELECT clinic_code AS clinic, 'Diagnosis codes, planned' AS evidence_source,
  CASE WHEN dx_planned_status_code <> 'unknown' THEN 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS answered_pct,
  CASE WHEN dx_planned_status_code = 'unknown' THEN NULL WHEN dx_planned_status_code = truth_status_code THEN 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS agree_pct
FROM health_transformation_lab.gold_perio_bench.fact_visit_evidence
UNION ALL

SELECT clinic_code AS clinic, 'Chart note' AS evidence_source,
  CASE WHEN note_status_code <> 'unknown' THEN 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS answered_pct,
  CASE WHEN note_status_code = 'unknown' THEN NULL WHEN note_status_code = truth_status_code THEN 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS agree_pct
FROM health_transformation_lab.gold_perio_bench.fact_visit_evidence
UNION ALL

SELECT clinic_code AS clinic, 'Gum measurements' AS evidence_source,
  CASE WHEN probing_chart_status_code <> 'unknown' THEN 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS answered_pct,
  CASE WHEN probing_chart_status_code = 'unknown' THEN NULL WHEN probing_chart_status_code = truth_status_code THEN 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS agree_pct
FROM health_transformation_lab.gold_perio_bench.fact_visit_evidence
UNION ALL

SELECT clinic_code AS clinic, 'Rules, measurements first (v0)' AS evidence_source,
  CASE WHEN rules_v0_status_code <> 'unknown' THEN 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS answered_pct,
  CASE WHEN rules_v0_status_code = 'unknown' THEN NULL WHEN rules_v0_status_code = truth_status_code THEN 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS agree_pct
FROM health_transformation_lab.gold_perio_bench.fact_visit_evidence
UNION ALL

SELECT clinic_code AS clinic, 'Rules, exam form first (design)' AS evidence_source,
  CASE WHEN rules_design_status_code <> 'unknown' THEN 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS answered_pct,
  CASE WHEN rules_design_status_code = 'unknown' THEN NULL WHEN rules_design_status_code = truth_status_code THEN 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS agree_pct
FROM health_transformation_lab.gold_perio_bench.fact_visit_evidence

datasets.name: concordance
queryLines:
SELECT method_a_name AS method_a, method_b_name AS method_b, ROUND(100 * agreement_ratio, 1) AS pct_agree,
  ROUND(kappa_coef, 2) AS kappa, visit_count AS n
FROM health_transformation_lab.gold_perio_bench.dq_source_concordance
WHERE level_code = 'status'

datasets.name: prevalence_clinic
queryLines:
SELECT group_name AS clinic, ROUND(100 * periodontitis_ratio, 1) AS periodontitis_pct,
  ROUND(100 * periodontitis_ci_low_ratio, 1) AS ci_low, ROUND(100 * periodontitis_ci_high_ratio, 1) AS ci_high,
  subject_count AS n
FROM health_transformation_lab.gold_perio_bench.dq_prevalence
WHERE level_code = 'clinic' AND method_name = 'algorithm_design'
ORDER BY group_name

datasets.name: prevalence_scale
queryLines:
SELECT method_name AS method, group_name AS scale, subject_count AS n,
  ROUND(100 * periodontitis_ratio, 1) AS periodontitis_pct, ROUND(100 * stage3_4_ratio, 1) AS stage3_4_pct
FROM health_transformation_lab.gold_perio_bench.dq_prevalence
WHERE level_code = 'scale'
ORDER BY method_name, group_name

datasets.name: transitions
queryLines:
SELECT from_status_code AS from_status, to_status_code AS to_status, visit_pair_count AS n,
  ROUND(row_pct, 1) AS row_pct, direction_code AS direction
FROM health_transformation_lab.gold_perio_bench.dq_stage_transition

datasets.name: temporal
queryLines:
SELECT method_name AS method, visit_pair_count AS pairs, ROUND(100 * better_ratio, 1) AS improved_pct,
  ROUND(100 * same_ratio, 1) AS same_pct, ROUND(100 * worse_ratio, 1) AS worse_pct,
  ROUND(100 * perio_resolved_ratio, 1) AS resolved_pct, ROUND(100 * stage_drop_ratio, 1) AS stage_drop_pct
FROM health_transformation_lab.gold_perio_bench.dq_temporal_change
ORDER BY improved_pct

datasets.name: injected
queryLines:
SELECT injected_error_count AS injected_errors, ROUND(100 * caught_ratio, 1) AS caught_pct,
  ROUND(100 * false_flag_ratio, 2) AS false_flag_pct
FROM health_transformation_lab.gold_perio_bench.dq_injected_error

datasets.name: mismatch_rules
queryLines:
SELECT rule_label_name AS rule, clinic_code AS clinic, checkable_count AS checkable, flagged_count AS flagged,
  ROUND(100 * precision_ratio, 1) AS precision_pct, ROUND(100 * recall_ratio, 1) AS recall_pct,
  only_rule_count AS only_this_rule, injected_caught_count AS injected_caught,
  injected_checkable_count AS injected_checkable
FROM health_transformation_lab.gold_perio_bench.dq_mismatch_rule
ORDER BY CASE WHEN clinic_code = 'All' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, clinic_code,
  CASE WHEN rule_name = 'any_rule' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, rule_name

datasets.name: mismatch_visits
queryLines:
SELECT m.visit_id, m.clinic_code AS clinic, v.visit_date, m.failed_rule_count AS rules_failed,
  m.rule_label_name AS rule, m.mismatch_evidence_text AS evidence
FROM health_transformation_lab.gold_perio_bench.fact_record_mismatch m
INNER JOIN health_transformation_lab.gold_perio_bench.fact_visit_evidence v ON m.visit_id = v.visit_id
ORDER BY m.failed_rule_count DESC, m.visit_id, m.rule_name

datasets.name: case_profile
queryLines:
WITH flagged AS (SELECT DISTINCT visit_id FROM health_transformation_lab.gold_perio_bench.fact_record_mismatch)
SELECT p.visit_id, p.category_name AS category, p.item_name AS item, p.item_value_name AS shown_value,
  p.item_unit_name AS unit, p.category_order_num, p.item_order_num
FROM health_transformation_lab.gold_perio_bench.fact_case_profile_item p
INNER JOIN flagged f ON p.visit_id = f.visit_id
ORDER BY p.visit_id, p.category_order_num, p.item_order_num

lines:
## EHR DQ grader: is this dental record fit for periodontal phenotyping?
**Synthetic data** from the study's generator, scored against its own truth: **not clinical performance**. The
light version of the Perio DQ Monitor design: five domains (Zozus completeness, accuracy and consistency; Kahn
temporal plausibility; reliability after de Vet et al. 2006), then one section per domain. Ask the **EHR DQ grader** Genie space for
anything not shown.

Tiles are for all clinics; the clinic filter applies to accuracy by source and prevalence. The checks table lists every clinic and All. Per-visit evidence is in `fact_visit_evidence` (statuses only, never note text).

frame.title: Completeness (%)
frame.description: Visits with exam form, diagnosis codes and gum measurements all present. All clinics.

frame.title: Accuracy (%)
frame.description: Rules on the whole record, measurements first (v0), against the truth, all visits.

frame.title: Consistency (points)
frame.description: Spread of periodontitis prevalence across the 8 clinics (design rules). Smaller is steadier.

frame.title: Temporal plausibility (%)
frame.description: Visit pairs 1–2 years apart, no treatment between, whose stage improved (design rules). Lower is better.

lines:
**Reliability** (de Vet)

**Not assessed**: needs real reviewers to label charts. Simulated reviewers are a dry run.

frame.title: Accuracy, exam form first (%)
frame.description: Rules in the study design's order. The order changes the answer.

frame.title: Missing by evidence column (%)
frame.description: Share of visits where the column is empty. Diagnosis codes done are missing as often as planned (29.5%); the per-source share answered is under Accuracy.

frame.title: Conformance, completeness and plausibility checks
frame.description: All = every clinic together. PASS: no failures allowed and none found; REPORT: a rate to read, with no pass mark.

frame.title: Visits each source gives a status for (%)
Agreement with the truth where it answers (%)
frame.description: Comparison to truth, the top rung of the accuracy hierarchy.

frame.title: Concordance between sources (%)
frame.description: Comparison to independent measurement, truth excluded.

frame.title: Periodontitis prevalence by clinic (%)
frame.description: Design rules; 95% intervals in the table.

frame.title: By scale: all visits, complete cases, reference set
Stage at one visit (rows) and the next (columns), % of the row
frame.description: Cells where the next visit's stage is lower than the earlier one show improvement: a charting or rule error unless treated.

frame.title: Implausible change by method
frame.description: Lower improved and resolved shares are more plausible.

frame.title: Injected charting errors the temporal checks catch (synthetic only)

## Records to recheck
**Synthetic records**, scored against the generator's truth: **not clinical performance**. Each rule asks whether a
visit's recorded code (the completed diagnosis code) fits the rest of its record. A flag is a record mismatch: a
coding or charting gap, not a clinical error. Precision and recall count only the visits a rule can check
(*checkable*); *only this rule* is how many of its flags no other rule makes. Pick a flagged visit to see its case
profile (spec 026, after KEEPER).

frame.title: Each rule against the truth (synthetic)
frame.description: All = every clinic; the clinic filter doesn't apply here, so All always shows. Blank precision or recall = the rule flags nothing there. Per-clinic injected-error counts are too few to compare.

frame.title: Flagged visits, most rules failed first
frame.description: One row per visit and failed rule. Rules failed counts all of the visit's rules, even when the rule filter shows only some of them.

frame.title: Case profile of the selected visit
frame.description: Pick a visit in the Visit filter; until then every flagged visit's profile is listed. Structured values only, never note text. Not recorded = the record lacks it.
